title: Onboarding, Mobile App by @adrianinmotion: It’s crazy to me how a simple animation can bring a brand to life and
notes:
It’s crazy to me how a simple animation can bring a brand to life and make it feel 10× more trustworthy and lovable, and yet so few companies actually capitalize on it... Motion = credibility + personality.
